title: Republic Act No. 11275
text:
H. No. 6512

Republic of the Philippiues
Congress of the Philippines
Metra Manila
Seventeenth Congress
Ghird Regular Seasian

Begun and held in Metro Manila, on Monday, the twenty-third
day of July, two thousand eighteen.

AN ACT CREATING A BARANGAY TO BE KNOWN AS
BARANGAY TIMBABAUAN IN THE MUNICIPALITY
OF TUNGAWAN, PROVINCE OF ZAMBOANGA
SIBUGAY

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. Creation of Barangay Timbabauan. — There
is hereby created a barangay to be known as Barangay
Timbabauan in the Municipality of Tungawan, Province of
Zamboanga Sibugay.

SEC. 2. Territorial Boundaries. — The territorial
boundaries of Barangay Timbabauan shall be identified as follows:

Bounded on the North, along line 3-4 by Barangay Gaycon;
along line 4-5 by Barangay of Masao;

On the East, along lines 5-6-7 by Barangay Libertad;
 
On the Southeast, along lines 7-1 by Barangay Tigbanuang;

On the Southwest, along line 1-2 by Barangay of Upper
Tungawan;

On the West, along line 2-3 by Barangay of Sisay, all of
Tungawan Municipality, Tungawan cadastre. PB-09-000019.

Beginning at a point marked “1” on plan, being
S. 47° 40' W., 5,467.792 meters from BLLM No. 1, Tungawan
cadastre;

Thence N. 53° 34' W., 1,081.774 m to point 2;
Thence N. 18° 48' E., 5,609.756 m to point 3;
Thence S. 69° 09' E., 1,341.253 m to point 4;
Thence S. 62° 51’ E., 899.162 m to point 5;
Thence S. 01° 55' W., 1,991.571 m to point 6;
Thence S. 12° 18'E., 1,123.236 m to point 7;
Thence S. 57° 59' W., 3,730.534 m to point 1

point of beginning; containing an area of 14,265,950 square
meters, more or less.

Sec. 3. Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. — The
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on
Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Provincial Ordinance No. 11,
series of 1991, dated October 8, 1991 of the Sangguniang
Panlalawigan of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur, which
ratified the creation of Barangay Timbabauan as proclaimed by
the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers on December 2, 1994 shall
serve as substantial compliance with the plebiscite requirement
under Section 10 of Republic Act No. 7160, as amended, otherwise
known as the “Local Government Code of 1991”.

SEc. 4. Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
barangay officials of Barangay Timbabauan shall continue to hold
office until such time that their successors have been duly elected
and qualified.

SEC. 5. Public Infrastructure and Facilities. — Allexisting
public infrastructure and facilities for public use therein at the

time of the approval of this Act are hereby transferred without
cost or compensation to and shall be administered by the new
barangay.

Sec. 6. Internal Revenue Allotment Shares. — Barangay
Timbabauan shall be entitled to Internal Revenue Allotment shares
pursuant to Section 285 of Republic Act No. 7160, as amended,
otherwise known as the “Local Government Code of 1991”.

SEC. 7. Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a
newspaper of general circulation.

Approved,
